content: The AHA 2014 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events during the American Heart Association's 2014 conference. The filming location is the Hyatt Regency McCormick Place, located at 2233 S. Martin Luther King Drive, Chicago, IL 60616. Below are the details of the scheduled interviews and open time slots for each day of the conference. Saturday, November 15, 2014 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Joseph Muhlestein on the topic of Screening for Asymptomatic Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease Among High-Risk Diabetic Patients Using Coronary CT Angiography: Primary Results of FACTOR-64, a Randomized Controlled Trial. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 17, 2014, at 11:07 AM. Sunday, November 16, 2014 8:45 AM 9:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Stefanie Schulz discussing Randomized, Double-Blind Trial of 6 Versus 12 Months of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy After DES-Implantation (ISAR-SAFE). The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 16, 2014, at 3:55 PM. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Kirk N. Garratt on Increased Risk of Ischemic Events Upon Discontinuation of Prasugrel After 12 or 30 Months of Therapy Following Placement of the Taxus Liberté Paclitaxel-Eluting Coronary Stent. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 16, 2014, at 4:05 PM. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Martine Gilard on Is 6 Months DAPT Post Coronary Stenting Non-Inferior to 24 Months? Results of the Italic/Italic+ Randomized Trial. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 16, 2014, at 4:05 PM. Monday, November 17, 2014 8:00 AM 8:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Christopher Granger and Dr. James Jollis on Developing Regional STEMI Systems of Care: Final Results of the Mission: Lifeline STEMI ACCELERATOR Study. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 19, 2014, at 11:41 AM. 8:30 AM 9:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Christoph Kaiser on Long-term Outcome of Biodegradable Compared to Durable Polymer Drug-Eluting Stents and Bare Metal Stents: Main Results of a Prospective Randomized Trial. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 19, 2014, at 10:45 AM. 9:00 AM 9:15 AM: Interview with Dr. Patrick Moriarty on ODYSSEY ALTERNATIVE: Efficacy and Safety of the PCSK9 Monoclonal Antibody, Alirocumab, Versus Ezetimibe, in Patients With Statin Intolerance. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 17, 2014, at 11:29 AM. 9:15 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Robert Giugliano on IMPROVE-IT Trial: A Comparison of Ezetimibe/Simvastatin Versus Simvastatin Monotherapy on Cardiovascular Outcomes After Acute Coronary Syndromes. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 17, 2014, at 11:51 AM. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Renato Lopes on AHA 2014 Wrap-Up in Portuguese. Tuesday, November 18, 2014 7:30 AM 8:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Robert Michler on The Surgical Treatment of Moderate Ischemic Mitral Regurgitation: A Randomized Clinical Trial From The Cardiothoracic Surgical Trials Network. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 18, 2014, at 11:51 AM. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Dean Kereiakes on Primary Outcomes of the EVOLVE II Trial: A Prospective Randomized Investigation of a Novel Bioabsorbable Polymer-Coated, Everolimus-Eluting Coronary Stent. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 19, 2014, at 10:55 AM. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Dion Stub on A Randomised Controlled Trial of Oxygen Therapy in Acute ST-segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction: The Air Versus Oxygen in Myocardial Infarction (AVOID) Study. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 19, 2014, at 11:19 AM. 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Hisao Ogawa on AHA 2014 Wrap-Up in Japanese. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Stefan James on AHA 2014 Wrap-Up from a Scandinavian Perspective. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Mark Dayer on The Incidence of Infective Endocarditis in England is Increasing: An Assessment of the Impact of Cessation of Antibiotic Prophylaxis Using Population Statistics. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 18, 2014, at 11:29 AM. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Interview with Dr. A. Verheugt on AHA 2014 Wrap-Up from a Netherlands Perspective. Wednesday, November 19, 2014 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Anna Axelsson on A Randomized Trial of Losartan in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: The INHERIT Trial. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 18, 2014, at 11:07 AM. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Laura Mauri on Risk and Benefit of Prolonged Dual Antiplatelet Therapy After Drug-Eluting Coronary Stents: Primary Endpoint Results from the Dual Antiplatelet Therapy Study. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 16, 2014, at 4:15 PM. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Westby Fisher on ABIM Maintenance of Certification Program.
